title: Utah National Parks Hikes GPX Routes, Mighty 5 Best Day Hikes, Zion Bryce Arches Trail Guide PDF, Hiking Passport, Road Trip Planner
description:
Utah's five national parks, told through ten of their best day hikes: a river walk through a slot canyon, trails among the hoodoos, and the arches that made the state famous. GPS routes, real photos, elevation profiles and a trail passport.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- 10 GPX route files plus a bonus Narrows extension, for AllTrails, Gaia GPS, Komoot or a GPS watch
- Route guide with a real photo, route map, elevation profile, trailhead logistics and tips for every trail
- A fillable Trail Passport to log every hike
- 10 collectible trail badges plus a shareable story image for every hike
- Canyon Overlook, Emerald Pools, The Narrows, Navajo Loop and Queen's Garden, Fairyland Loop, Delicate Arch, The Windows and Double Arch, Mesa Arch, Hickman Bridge and Cassidy Arch

WHAT YOU GET
- GPX route files for AllTrails, Gaia GPS, Komoot or your GPS watch
- Route guide PDF in US Letter, A4 and a mobile edition
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Trail data from the National Park Service and OpenStreetMap contributors; photos via Wikimedia Commons with credits in the guide. Desert heat and flash floods are real: check the park's page and the forecast before you go. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable hiking guides in our Etsy shop.
